name: Sakae (Nagano, Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Sakae village emblem in purple and white: a purple lozenge bearing a white stylised figure.
history: Municipal flag of Sakae, a village in Nagano Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Sakae village emblem — a purple lozenge bearing a white stylised figure
